items.body_raw: אֶשְׁמְרָה תוֹרָתְךָ תָמִיד
items.answer_raw: I would keep thy law continually.

items.body_raw: נִכְרְתָה בְרִית אֲנִי וְאַתָּה וְהָיָה לְעֵד בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ
items.answer_raw: Let us make a covenant, I and thou, and it shall be for a witness between me and thee.

items.body_raw: אָמַר אַבְרָהָם אֶל־בְּנֵי חֵת מִכְרוּ לִי קֶבֶר וְאֶקְבְּרָה מֵתִי מִלְּפָנָי
items.answer_raw: Abraham said to the Hittites, Sell me a grave, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

items.body_raw: אַל־תִּקְצֹף יהוה עַד־מְאֹד
items.answer_raw: Be not very angry, O Yahweh.

items.body_raw: אַל־תִּקְרַב הֲלֹם כִּי הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עוֹמֵד עָלָיו אַדְמַת קֹדֶשׁ הוּא
items.answer_raw: Draw not nigh hither, for the place whereon thou art standing is holy ground.

items.body_raw: אָמַר יַעֲקֹב אֶל־עֵשָׂו מִכְרָה כַיּוֹם אֶת־בְּכֹרָתְךָ לִי וַיִּמְכֹּר לוֹ אֶת־בְּכֹרָתוֹ
items.answer_raw: Jacob said to Esau, First sell me thy birthright; and he sold him his birthright.

items.body_raw: אָמַר יהוה הֵן הָאָדָם הָיָה כֵּאלֹהִים יֹדֵעַ טוֹב וָרָע וְעַתָּה פֶּן־יִשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וְלָקַח מֵעֵץ הַחַיִּים וְאָכַל וָחַי לְעוֹלָם
items.answer_raw: Yahweh said, Behold, the man is become as God, knowing good and evil; and now, lest he put forth his hand and take of the tree of life and eat and live for ever.

items.body_raw: וְהַמַּיִם גָּבְרוּ מְאֹד מְאֹד עַל־הָאָרֶץ וַיִּגְוַע כָּל־בָּשָׂר הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל־הָאָרֶץ בָּעוֹף וּבַבְּהֵמָה וְכֹל הָאָדָם
items.answer_raw: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth, and all flesh expired that moved upon the earth, among birds and cattle, and all mankind.

items.body_raw: וְהָיָה כָעָם כַּכֹּהֵן וּפָקַדְתִּי עָלָיו מַעֲלָלָיו וְאָכְלוּ וְלֹא יִשְׂבָּעוּ כִּי אֶת־יהוה עָזָבוּ
items.answer_raw: And it shall be, like people, like priest, and I will visit his deeds upon him; and they shall eat, and not be satisfied, for Yahweh they have forsaken.

items.body_raw: נקרבה אל־יהוה וישפט ביני ובינך
items.answer_raw: Let us draw nigh to Yahweh, that he may judge between me and thee.

items.body_raw: וישכחו בני־ישראל את־יהוה אלהיהם וימכר אותם ביד מלך מואב
items.answer_raw: And the Israelites forgot Yahweh their God and he sold them into the hand of the king of Moab.

items.body_raw: Thou shalt not lie down in that place.
items.answer_raw: לֹא תִשְׁכַּב בַּמָּקוֹם הַהוּא

items.body_raw: Let me lie down.
items.answer_raw: אֶשְׁכְּבָה

items.body_raw: Do not (ye) draw near.
items.answer_raw: אַל־תִּקְרְבוּ

items.body_raw: May Yahweh judge between me and (between) this people.
items.answer_raw: יִשְׁפֹּט יְהוָה בֵּינִי וּבֵין הָעָם הַזֶּה

items.body_raw: Hear my prayer (O) our God.
items.answer_raw: שְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתִי אֱלֹהֵינוּ (or שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי (emphatic imperative))

items.body_raw: Sell to me this cave that I may bury my dead there.
items.answer_raw: מִכְרוּ לִי אֶת־הַמְּעָרָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶקְבְּרָה אֶת־מֵתִי שָׁם

items.body_raw: The man ate of the tree which (was) in the garden and God was very angry.
items.answer_raw: אָכַל הָאִישׁ מִן־הָעֵץ אֲשֶׁר בַּגָּן וַיִּקְצֹף אֱלֹהִים מְאֹד

items.body_raw: And the calf I took and burnt it with (in the) fire.
items.answer_raw: וְאֶת־הָעֵגֶל לָקַחְתִּי וָאֶשְׂרֹף אֹתוֹ בָּאֵשׁ

items.body_raw: Thus saith (perf.) Yahweh: Behold I will-give (ptc.) this city into the hand of the king of Bābel, and he will burn it with fire.
items.answer_raw: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הִנֵּה אֲנִי נֹתֵן אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וְשָׂרַף אֹתָהּ בָּאֵשׁ

items.body_raw: Sarah bare to her husband a son, and the boy grew up.
items.answer_raw: יָלְדָה שָׂרָה לְאִישָׁהּ בֵּן וַיִּגְדַּל הַיֶּלֶד

items.body_raw: And God called the light (dat.) day and the darkness he called night.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּקְרָא אֱלֹהִים לָאוֹר יוֹם וְלַחֹשֶׁךְ קָרָא לָיְלָה

items.body_raw: And thou shalt keep his law continually.
items.answer_raw: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־תּוֹרָתוֹ תָּמִיד

items.body_raw: And I remembered his words.
items.answer_raw: וָאֶזְכֹּר אֶת־דְּבָרָיו

items.body_raw: And it shall be, like prophet, like priest.
items.answer_raw: וְהָיָה כַנָּבִיא כַּכֹּהֵן
